sources.quote:
For siRNA-Cy5-LNP, a fixed dose of 1mg/kg was systemically injected, and brains were harvested 2.5 hours post-treatment.
At the highest PNP of 400 kPa, the opening was accompanied by microhemorrhage
measurements were: 4.03 + 0.42 at 400 kPa, 3.428 + 0.245 at 220 kPa, and 3.25 + 0.11 at 180 kPa

issues: Widths are descriptive reported means (4.03,3.428,3.25mm), not evidence of significant differences between every pair.
Pressure-arm intensity comparisons are NS and deliberately unscored; equal gold tiers are not imposed.
Histology labels are observations at the reported endpoint, not equivalence, zero-risk or long-term safety.
Exact MB count and total sonication duration remain missing; no executable protocol claimed.
No exact fluorescence intensity per pressure accepted
Unperfused brain fluorescence may include vascular label; not unequivocal intracellular delivery
No functional gene silencing; non-template siRNA cannot establish therapeutic knockdown
Source says delivery not compromised from NS; no noninferiority/equivalence test
Do not compare absolute intensities across dyes, cargo classes or assays as delivery efficiency
reference.validation_scope: source-record alignment, scoring contract and payload checks; not an independent experimental replication
